# Zircon Dental & Implant Clinic

> Zircon Dental & Implant Clinic is a dental clinic located in Wakad, Pune, Maharashtra, India, offering dental implants, immediate-load implants, root canal treatment, orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry, crowns & bridges, oral surgery, and child dentistry.

## Entity Information
- Legal/Trade Name: Zircon Dental & Implant Clinic (also operating as Zircon Dental & Implant Studio)
- Type: Dentist / Dental Clinic
- Website: https://www.zircondentalandimplantstudio.com
- Phone: +91 75586 97707
- Email: Zircondental77@gmail.com
- Address: Shop No. 72, Western Avenue, Western High St, opposite Phoenix Mall Road, Shankar Kalat Nagar, Wakad, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Maharashtra 411057, India
- Area served: Wakad, Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Hinjewadi, Baner, Balewadi, Aundh (Maharashtra, India)
- Coordinates: 18.602580, 73.754166
- Working hours: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM

## Key People
- Dr. Akansha Lakde — Chief Dental Surgeon & Implantologist, MDS - Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery
- Dr. Manoj Kumar Anarase — Chief Dental Surgeon & Head Dentist, BDS

## Core Services
- Dental Implants (single tooth, implant-supported bridge, All-on-4/All-on-6)
- Immediate Load Implants (Same-Day Dental Implants)
- Advanced Implants (All-on-4, All-on-6, zygomatic implants, full mouth rehabilitation)
- Root Canal Treatment (single-visit and multi-visit)
- Smile Design (digital smile design, veneers)
- Teeth Whitening
- Crowns & Bridges
- Orthodontics (metal braces, ceramic braces, clear aligners, lingual braces)
- Oral Surgery (extractions, wisdom tooth removal, bone grafting, sinus lift)
- Child Dentistry (pediatric checkups, fluoride treatment, pulpotomy, space maintainers)
